from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper found in the collection, including which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    referenced_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
